quarterly_data.quarter: Moore Threads results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (04-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Board secretary and CFO Xue Yansong (results briefing): Q1 2026 revenue was RMB 7.38 hundred million, up 155.35% year on year; Q1 R&D spending was RMB 3.69 hundred million, up about 50%; the company stepped up raw-material purchases and strategic stocking to meet demand growth and keep the supply chain stable.

quarterly_data.quarter: Moore Threads results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (04-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Co-founder Zhou Yuan (results briefing): the disclosed RMB 6.6 hundred million major contract is for an intelligent-computing cluster, a significant win for its full-function GPU cards and KUAE system-level solution in very-large-scale AI infrastructure.

quarterly_data.quarter: Moore Threads results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (04-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Products (results briefing): the Huagang-architecture 'Lushan' graphics chip is expected to deliver 15x 3A-game rendering, 64x AI performance and 50x ray-tracing versus prior products (launch timing per later official release); the MTT C256 supernode architecture plan was released in December 2025; the KUAE 10,000-card cluster reaches 10 Exa-Flops; on April 24 the company completed Day-0 adaptation of DeepSeek V4 on the MTT S5000 using native FP8; it has over 45 ten-thousand developers and learners; and it launched the MTT AIBOOK built on its 'Changjiang' edge SoC.
quarterly_data.figure: KUAE cluster 10 Exa-Flops; Lushan: 15x rendering, 64x AI, 50x ray tracing
